scope.selection: All 23 still-uninspected reports submitted through the two remaining shortener hosts, followed by the earliest seven of nine still-uninspected reports submitted as public sink pages

method.source: Existing public urlquery report JSON only
method.collection: The bounded review helper read each report's public /json representation without following redirects and exported hashes, static operation counts and domain-level archived traffic only.
method.prohibited_actions: No short link, carrier, sink topic, target, recovered program, scanner submission or archived request was opened, executed, replayed or contacted.
method.publication_boundary: No short-link path, sink path, topic, payload, message body, credential, submitter address or private log is retained.

known_family_overlap.assessment: Every report reaches the public visualization host already associated with the published AIHW experiment. This ties the records to the known comparison family; it does not establish an independent episode or population.

channel_structure.assessment: Endpoint reuse and repeated GETs establish neither an author nor a task-bearing transfer. Empty archived responses cannot show recipient acquisition or downstream semantic use.

host_groups.recorded_shape: Redirects into ordinary HTTP-test traffic and the known AIHW visualization host; no channel request is preserved.
host_groups.assessment: All eight exact IDs occur in the full pinned comparison snapshot, and their archived destination and timing remain inside the known family.

The seven channel-bearing reports preserve GET-only empty responses; the other eight preserve redirect and HTTP-test traffic. None preserves a sender-produced task artifact or a recipient's dependent action.

Submitted sink pages expose several one-way endpoint hashes and repeated reads, but every preserved response is empty. The reports also reach the known AIHW surface and do not identify autonomous authors or demonstrate result use.

alternatives_tested: Known AIHW experiment traffic mistaken for a separate population because a scanner ID is absent from the comparison release
Shortener redirects mistaken for sender-to-recipient handoffs
Repeated empty channel reads mistaken for retrieval and use of task work
Multiple one-way endpoint hashes mistaken for independently attributable autonomous participants
Scanner retries, rate limits and repeated captures mistaken for semantic dependencies

evidence_state.provider_attribution: The archived destination overlaps the known AIHW experiment; no separate provider-model execution is established.
evidence_state.ongoing_activity: not established; all selected events occurred on 20-21 June 2026

novelty_check: No episode-level prior-reporting search was warranted. All thirty exact IDs occur in the full pinned comparison snapshot and resolve to the already reported AIHW family before the participant, transfer/use and authorization tests.
advancement_evidence: A separate episode would require public provenance for a specific autonomous sender, a task-bearing artifact, a distinguishable recipient's later acquisition and causal use, and primary evidence that their cooperation exceeded authorization. Nonempty archived content alone would still require semantic and operator-boundary evidence.
